import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def task_func(matrix1, matrix2):
    matrix1 = np.asarray(matrix1)
    matrix2 = np.asarray(matrix2)
    combined = np.concatenate((matrix1, matrix2), axis=1)
    df = pd.DataFrame(combined)
    return df.to_string(index=False, header=False)
